request.instructions:
You write short re-cleaning requests for a cleaner. For each item below write one request.

Rules:
- Write each request in English plus an English version for the host.
- For a problem item: say what to fix and ask for a new photo afterwards.
- For an item that needs proof: say exactly what to photograph.
- Keep each request to one sentence.
- Examples (in English): "Clean the stain at the back of the microwave and send a new photo." / "Send a photo of the hand towel in the guest bathroom."

Items:
- laundry.machines (Laundry room): Washer empty - Washer lid open: drum empty, no clothes or towels left inside [status: needs proof - No photo shows it]
- laundry.floor_clear (Laundry room): Floor clear - Floor is clean: nothing left on it, no spots, spills or crumbs [status: problem - White laundry pile left on floor near door, floor not clear.]
- laundry.lint_filter (Laundry room): Dryer lint filter clean - Dryer lint filter pulled out and emptied: no layer of lint on the screen (a few specks are fine) [status: needs proof - No photo shows it]
- laundry.dryer (Laundry room): Dryer empty - Dryer door open: drum empty, no clothes or towels left inside [status: needs proof - No photo shows it]
- laundry.no_dirty_linens (Laundry room): No dirty linens left - No dirty sheets, towels or clothes left in baskets or on the floor [status: problem - Laundry room with washer dryer visible, but pile of white laundry left on floor by door.]
